title: vitals --json output
description: The document printed by `vitals --json`. Field names are a contract: within one `schema_version` they do not drift. Adding fields is not a breaking change, so readers should ignore keys they do not recognise; only incompatible changes bump `schema_version`.

entries.description: One item per rendered line, in display order. Layout-only primitives (separator, break, colors) are omitted.

type.description: Module name, for example "os". The title line uses "title" and carries an empty key.

key.description: Label printed before the colon. Empty for the title line.

value.description: The value as printed. Human-readable text, so volatile fields (uptime, memory usage, rates) differ between runs.

failures.description: Modules whose collection failed. Empty when everything worked; the same failures are also warned about on stderr.

type.description: Module name exactly as the user wrote it, even when it is not a known module.

error.description: Failure reason: the same sentence that is printed on the terminal.
